response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to event-driven systems and agentic tooling, but lacks demonstrable production-scale multi-agent AI systems in fintech, regulatory compliance experience, and leadership scaling teams beyond 10–15 people — critical gaps for this executive CTO role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven track record in event-driven, distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering culture advocacy via workshops, TDD, and open-source tooling
concerns: No evidence of building or operating multi-agent AI systems in regulated fintech environments
Lacks documented experience scaling engineering teams beyond 10–15 people or leading senior technical leadership layers
No mention of real-time credit risk, working-capital algorithms, or financial compliance infrastructure
